name: Friday the 13th Zero
source:
Interactive Horror Visual Novel. Have you ever wanted to control the choices of the actors in an slasher movie? Like: "Don't go in there!" or "Get out of there!"? If yes, then this game is for you.

1 Year after the death of Mrs. Voorhess during the birthday of his drowned son, Jason, a group of six teenagers go back to Camp Crystal Lake looking for adventure. But none of them expected what will happen.

Placed between the first and second movies of Friday the 13th. Go and live the most terrifying night of your life in Camp Blood.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/friday_the_13th_zero.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
